7084-7272-8293.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-8293.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

851-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
851-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6792-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6792-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

579-1978-2347-5793.description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding four mana due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Firemind Vessel which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

1580-2511-4871-6255.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6147-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6147-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6147-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

578-7282.notablePrerequisites: You have three or more artifact cards in hand.
578-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Metalworker with haste.
Activate the Metalworker token by tapping it, revealing three artifact cards from your hand and adding six {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1395-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1395-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-4823--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-4823--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

586-2511-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2350-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

339-413-677-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2034-3817-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

277-5414-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-5414-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

4508-4772-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-1308-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4050-4770-5457-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it, Selvala and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Resolve the Selvala trigger, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cat and Mercenary, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1909-4486-4734.notablePrerequisites: Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness. Cradle Clearcutter has power 2 or greater who has at least a +1/+0 boost from secondary effects.
1909-4486-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Repeat.
1909-4486-4734.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

3430-4499-4826-5954.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

874-4708-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
874-4708-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

2952-4067-5242.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer's Wand attached to Lu Xun.
Lu Xun does not have summoning sickness.
2952-4067-5242.description:
Activate Lu Xun by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Lu Xun triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lu Xun.
Repeat.

1467-2499-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2499-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

511-3008-3048-5296.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Sporoloth Ancient has at least one spore counter on it.
511-3008-3048-5296.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient and two +1/+1 counters on Workhorse.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.Activate Workhorse twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2201-4596.description:
Godhead of Awe causes all other creatures to have base power and toughness 1/1.
Because Reverence prevents creatures with power two or less from attacking you, no creatures can attack you.

1817-2743-4285.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {3}{R}{R}, copying Double Major twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Double Majors, creating three copies of the Biovisionary spells.
Resolve all Biovisionary spells, causing you to have a nontoken Biovisionary and three token Biovisionaries.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1308-1645-2832-4050.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting Brine Comber.
Brine Comber triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

703-3094-3807.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, its ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Swift Reconfiguration by paying {W}, attaching it to Astral Dragon and causing Astral Dragon to become a Vehicle artifact with no other card types.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's trigger from step 2, targeting Astral Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger, targeting the nontoken Astral Dragon.
Resolve the first Astral Dragon token's trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 6.

1528-4721-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature you control without summoning sickness.
1528-4721-5195.description:
Cast Tawnos's Tinkering by paying {3}{G}, targeting any applicable permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Tawnos's Tinkering, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos's Tinkering, putting two +1/+1 counters on the creature with Dual Casting attached and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

575-2795-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thelonite Hermit, adding {G}.
Thelonite Hermit dies, triggering Yedora, returning Thelonite Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Thelonite Hermit by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thelonite Hermit's morph ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, turning it face up.
Thelonite Hermit triggers, creating four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1771-2177-3096.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, searching for all land cards in your library, exiling them and shuffling your library.
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling the rest of your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1395-1414-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

501-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
501-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2399-3066-4050.description:
Sacrifice Doomed Dissenter to activate Phyrexian Altar, adding {B}.
Doomed Dissenter's death trigger creates a 2/2 Zombie token.
Sacrifice the Zombie to activate Phyrexian Altar, adding {B}.
Return Doomed Dissenter to your hand using Colfenor's trigger.
Repeat.

225-2404-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
225-2404-2816.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
